description: This file provides localization support for a Flutter app, loading language-specific JSON (ARB-like) files from assets, managing locale state, and exposing localization data via a delegate and helper classes.

classes.name: AppLocalizations
classes.description: Handles loading and providing localized strings based on the current locale.

classes.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate
classes.description: Provides the localization delegate for Flutter's localization system.

classes.name: AppLocaleController
classes.description: Manages runtime locale changes and notifies listeners accordingly.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.of
methods.description: Retrieves the current application localizations instance from the widget tree.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.t
methods.description: Returns the localized string corresponding to the given key.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.load
methods.description: Loads localization data from the asset file based on the given locale.

methods.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate.isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given locale is supported.

methods.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate.load
methods.description: Loads localization data for a locale.

methods.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate.shouldReload
methods.description: Determines if the delegate should reload when configuration changes.

methods.name: AppLocaleController.setLocale
methods.description: Updates the current locale and notifies listeners.
